crossRefs.note: Only let your way of life be worthy of the Good News of Christ, that whether I come and see you or am absent, I may…
make my joy full by being like-minded, having the same love, being of one accord, of one mind;
For God has put in their hearts to do what he has in mind, to be of one mind, and to give their kingdom to the beast…
Alas Assyrian, the rod of my anger, the staff in whose hand is my indignation!
“ ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “It will happen in that day that things will come into your mind, and you will devise an evil…
to do whatever your hand and your council foreordained to happen.

translations.web: These have one mind, and they give their power and authority to the beast.
translations.bsb: These kings have one purpose: to yield their power and authority to the beast.
translations.kjv: These have one mind, and shall give their power and strength unto the beast.
translations.asv: These have one mind, and they give their power and authority unto the beast.
